role: CI gate for docs/REFACTOR_SPEC.md: counts functions and computed properties/inits/closure-initialised properties over 20 body lines or nested deeper than 2, commented-out code lines, empty catches, justified waivers and malformed waivers in Emuqu (and a combined count for the watch app) against .ci budgets.
toplevel: cd to repo root. SCAN_DIR=Emuqu (missing -> 2). Every budget is read with `$(read_budget ...) || exit $?`, so a missing or non-integer budget file exits 2. MEASURED=measure_spec Emuqu (empty -> 2); first line parsed into 9 counts; prints report; over() for each axis (empty catches and malformed waivers against 0); any over -> worst offenders + exit 1; below-budget hints. Watch: budget file missing -> 2, non-integer -> 2; measure_spec on watch dir; total of 4 axes vs .ci/spec_watch_budget.txt (0); over -> exit 1. Else clean.

units.does: Prints the whitespace-stripped content of .ci/<name>; exits 2 (from the $( ) subshell, which every call site turns into the script exit with `|| exit $?`) if the file is missing or its content is not a non-negative integer.

Runs embedded Python over directory $1: for every *.swift, counts commented-out code lines (outside Usage/Example blocks), statement-less catch bodies, malformed swallow-ok markers; finds func/computed-var/init/subscript/closure-initialised declarations, locates the body brace by paren/bracket depth, measures body lines and nesting relative to the body; >20 lines or depth >2 counts as long/deep (func vs prop axis) unless a `// spec:long-function <why>` / `// spec:deep-nesting <why>` waiver sits in the comment block above; bare markers counted malformed. Prints one line of 9 counts, then BADWAIVER/LONG/DEEP rows (top 5 each).
If actual > budget (arithmetic), prints '<label> is X, over budget Y' to stderr and sets global FAILED=1.
